title: Distribution profiling
description: Plot histograms for all numeric columns and a bar chart for salary_band. Run Shapiro-Wilk on performance_rating. Verify employee_id uniqueness.

title: Bivariate correlation analysis
description: Compute Pearson and Spearman correlations for every numeric feature against performance_rating. Record r, rho, and raw p-values. Generate a full pairwise heatmap and scatter plots for the top-4 correlated features.

title: Categorical target comparison
description: Run one-way ANOVA of performance_rating across salary_band levels. Produce a box plot.

title: Multicollinearity assessment
description: Compute VIF for all numeric predictors (excluding employee_id and performance_rating). Report condition number of the design matrix.

title: OLS regression null-signal test
description: Fit OLS regression of performance_rating on all features (one-hot encode salary_band). Report R², adjusted R², global F-test statistic and p-value. Compare 5-fold cross-validated RMSE against mean-baseline RMSE.

title: Random-forest permutation importance
description: Train a random-forest regressor (default hyperparameters, 100 trees) with 5-fold CV. Compute permutation importance for each feature and plot with 95% confidence intervals.

title: Multiple-testing correction and bootstrap CIs
description: Collect all raw p-values from EXP-02 and EXP-03. Apply Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg corrections. Separately, bootstrap 1000 resamples to build 95% CIs for each Pearson correlation coefficient.
